proposals.before: After Jingzhou fell the court moved to Wuchang, where Shi Yi became a rear-guard general, then village marquis at the metropolitan gate, while remaining palace attendant.
proposals.after: After Jingzhou fell the court moved to Wuchang, where Shi Yi became a subordinate general (pi jiangjun), then village marquis of the capital precinct, while remaining palace attendant.
proposals.reason: 裨將軍 is subordinate/assistant general, not “rear-guard general” (後將軍).

proposals.before: Yet Guang left a year ago and not a word has returned—did my message ever reach you? I gaze south and sigh as the months pass; even Lu Wang and Gao Zi scarcely match my longing! And now I am treated coldly; slander never stops—I am sure to suffer for it, only sooner or later.
proposals.after: Yet Guang left a year ago and not a word has returned—did my message ever reach you? I gaze south and sigh as the months pass; even Lu’s longing for Gaozi scarcely matches this! And now I am treated coldly; slander never stops—I am sure to suffer for it, only sooner or later.
proposals.reason: 魯望高子 is the classic allusion “Lu longed for Gaozi,” not two men named Lu Wang and Gao Zi.

proposals.before: Chen Shou concludes that Shi Yi, Xu Xiang, and Hu Zong were the men who kept Sun Quan's government running.
proposals.after: The appraisal states that Shi Yi, Xu Xiang, and Hu Zong were the men who kept Sun Quan's government running.
proposals.reason: Chinese 評曰 does not name Chen Shou; the English invents the historian’s name.

proposals.before: Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the cauldron and cauldron, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.
proposals.after: Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the cauldron and wok, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.
proposals.reason: Duplicate “cauldron and cauldron” for 鼎鑊; second vessel is a wok/cauldron pair.

decisions.reason: 拜裨將軍 names the subordinate/assistant generalship 裨將軍, not 後將軍 “rear-guard general”; 都亭侯 is the capital-precinct village marquis. The proposed idiomatic line corrects both mistranslations without adding unsupported content.
胡綜字偉則 is fully conveyed by the existing name-plus-courtesy gloss; appending only a period is stylistic and still leaves an incomplete sentence, so the change does not repair a real semantic error.
魯望高子 is the classical allusion of Lu longing for Gaozi, not two persons Lu Wang and Gao Zi; the proposed wording restores that sense and removes the invented name Lu Wang.
評曰 introduces the historian’s appraisal without naming Chen Shou; “Chen Shou concludes” invents an attribution absent from the Chinese, and “The appraisal states” matches 評曰.

decisions.after: Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the tripod and the cauldron, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.
decisions.reason: 鼎鑊 is the paired execution vessels ding and huo; “cauldron and cauldron” wrongly duplicates one gloss, but “cauldron and wok” is awkward for this punishment context—render the pair as tripod and cauldron.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows the spaced English personal-name “Gao Zi” (with null zh/pinyin) was created only by the bad two-person reading of 魯望高子; the valid Gaozi name remains in c0165.
